fit.label: First screen of the product page (phone)
fit.help: On a phone the first screen of every product page reaches down to the sizes and the measurement line, just above the buy buttons. The photo's height is what gives way: it is never shorter than its floor nor taller than its ceiling (each the smaller of a pixel number and a share of the screen). The air above the buy bar is in pixels. While the photo stays at least the 'deep' share of the screen, a deeper block may end the first screen. On a very short phone the gaps between the blocks may give a few pixels too.

rows.label: Rows under the product: "Wear it with" and "Recently viewed"
rows.help: Sliding rows at the foot of every product page. "Wear it with" shows other categories' products: tops for a bottom garment, bottoms for a top, in the order of the lists (a category with its own list uses that one first; a missing or empty category is skipped). Then "You may also like" rows of the next categories. On a computer the rows can be one slider together. "Recently viewed" shows the products this phone opened before (only their numbers are kept on the phone); on a computer it can be a grid of 4 that is never empty and changes every few seconds — a hand on it, a finger or the keyboard pauses it.

icons.label: Floating buttons beside the product (wishlist, WhatsApp)
icons.help: A column of round buttons at the right of every product page that drifts a little as the page scrolls, never above the title and never onto the buy bar. Off by default: the heart then sits right after the product's name. Choose where the wishlist heart goes (after the title, in the column, or nowhere), and whether the column has "Ask about this item on WhatsApp" (shown only when the store's WhatsApp number is filled in). The drift numbers are in pixels and milliseconds.

share.label: Share row on the product page
share.help: The "Share this product" button in the floating column opens a row of floating tiles: Facebook, Messenger (phones only, it opens the app), WhatsApp, Instagram (the phone's own share sheet, or the link copied) and Copy link. Choose which tiles show and their order. The row closes when a tile is used, on a tap anywhere else, on the button again, or by itself after the time set here (milliseconds). The button shows only when the floating column and its Share button are on.

fab.label: Floating WhatsApp button on every page
fab.help: A round WhatsApp button that floats over the shop's pages. Off: the WhatsApp icon in the header does this job (owner's decision of 19 Oct). When on, tick the kinds of page that show it (home, category, product, bag, help pages, wishlist, account, any other), the side, and where it sits: low, just above the phone's bottom bars (recommended), or in the middle of the side. It steps out of the way over the footer, and never shows until the store's WhatsApp number is filled in.

menuSubs.label: Sub-categories in the phone menu
menuSubs.help: How the phone menu shows a category's sub-categories (a category with none is a plain link). Accordion (recommended): a tap on the category opens its sub-categories in place, "View all" first, and a second tap closes them. List: always shown, indented under the category. Off: the category goes straight to its page. Counts shows the number of products beside each; one at a time closes the open category when another opens. Sub-categories with no products for sale are left out.

list.label: Wishlist
list.help: The hearts a shopper taps are kept for his browser (no login needed) and listed on the wishlist page. Max: the most products one list keeps — past it a heart says the list is full, nothing is dropped. Empty-list picks: on a computer, an empty list shows this many of the newest products (0 = none). Move from the bag: on, the heart button on a bag line says "Move to wishlist" and moves the item to the list, with Undo; off, it says "Save for later" and keeps it in the bag. A combo always stays whole in the bag's saved list.

help.label: Help pages
help.help: The help pages at /help/…: questions and answers, delivery, exchange and returns, privacy, terms, our story and contact. Switch each one on or off, and choose which live Smart Rules it shows (their texts, in this order: a rule that is not live is left out). The FAQ also shows every live rule placed on "FAQ". Store details: under privacy the e-mail and hotline, under terms the registered name, address, trade licence and DBID (each only when filled in). A page with nothing to show says "Coming soon". On a computer the pages sit in a help centre with the topics on the left (choose which, in order) and WhatsApp and the hotline on the right. "Still need a hand?" adds the WhatsApp button under each page.

text.label: Words on the help pages
text.help: Your own words on each help page: a title and a short line under it (both optional: the shop has its own), and the page's text. In the text, an empty line starts a new paragraph, a line starting with "## " is a heading and lines starting with "- " are a list. Privacy, terms and our story show only your words, so they say "Coming soon" until you write them. Your own questions and answers go on the FAQ, before the answers from your Smart Rules. In English and Bengali.
